PLUGIN_CONFIG_CONFLICT.scenario: Same-process policy or scheduler domain differs from its existing group; use matching options.

PLUGIN_SHUTDOWN_CLEANUP_FAILED.scenario: Shutdown timer cancellation or the captured exit failed; inspect ordered cleanup causes.

PLUGIN_UNINSTALL_CLEANUP_FAILED.scenario: Final uninstall attempted every restoration/removal but cleanup failed; inspect its causes.

PROCESS_INSTALL_ROLLBACK_FAILED.scenario: Installation and rollback both failed; the original install error remains first in errors.

RUNTIME_SHUTTING_DOWN.scenario: The same process group has begun shutdown; do not install more hosts into that group.
